verdict.rationale: PlanetScale has no documented first-class automation object that can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. The closest evidence is indirect: recurring agent workflows deliver their changes as pull requests that can be reviewed in git, and schema changes go through branches and deploy requests for review before production. missing for 10: versioning of automation definitions, review workflow for the automations themselves, rollback of automations, any revert/undo evidence for deploy requests, independent corroboration.
